biocontainers.name: bioconductor-subcellbarcode
biocontainers.summary: SubCellBarCode: Integrated workflow for robust mapping and visualizing whole human spatial proteome

biotools.summary: Mass-Spectrometry based spatial proteomics have enabled the proteome-wide mapping of protein subcellular localization (Orre et al. 2019, Molecular Cell). SubCellBarCode R package robustly classifies proteins into corresponding subcellular localization.
